process.textSurvey: Whole source TXT independently searched for vehicle-type lines, challenge-level statblocks, walkers, speeders, airspeeders, escape pods, stations, lifeboats, and chassis/stock-ship tables.
process.primaryPdf: Book PDF SHA-256 checked; missing Escape Pod visually read at physical PDF page 51 / printed p50; 104 existing source close-reads reused from printed pp 56-160.
process.duplicateReview: Compare all enumerated records against historical 104-claim SotG provenance and canonical JSON; maintain single hybrid and same-book publication identity.
process.visualReviewScope: Escape Pod page rendered and manually checked; other 104 inherit previous PDF checks. No claim every printed page individually re-rendered.
process.discoveryGapCaveat: Independent searchable TXT survey plus targeted PDF validation; an OCR-missing standalone entry on an unreviewed page is possible and should be amended when discovered.

candidateDispositions.reason: Full separate heading, printed type line, defenses, HP, movement, crew, cost in starship modification rules; missing from original 104.
Descriptive modular escape system; no standalone complete vehicle statblock.
